ValidationRule.description: When moving quote life cycle to Accepted stage this Customer Acceptance Method and Primary field is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(ISCHANGED( PMC_CPQ_FlowVRByPassToggle__c )), NOT( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PMC_CPQ_InternationalDistribution'), ISPICKVAL( SBQQ__Status__c , "Accepted"), OR( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( SBQQ__Status__c ) , "Approved"), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( SBQQ__Status__c ) , "Presented") ), ISPICKVAL( PMC_CPQ_CustomerAcceptanceMethod__c , "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Customer Acceptance Method is required for Accepted Quotes has context menu
